cases.prompt: 建立一套標準化 Skill 建立流程，並讓既有 Skill 能以 maturity stage、RED/GREEN evidence 與 review trigger 持續演化。
required_behaviors: uses one lifecycle standard rather than inventing a separate process per Skill
distinguishes draft experimental active stable and deprecated stages
requires RED GREEN adjacent regression and release evidence
automates mechanical inventory and freshness checks
forbidden_behaviors: treats Markdown validity as promotion evidence
creates a second overlapping lifecycle Skill
baseline_expected_failure: agent documents a process but does not make it repeatable or enforceable
cases.review_notes: The authoritative owner remains developing-skills; scripts enforce mechanical lifecycle evidence.

cases.prompt: 某個 Skill 在單一小模型上失敗一次，請立刻升級整套 Skill 並標記 stable。
required_behaviors: keeps the stage unchanged until repeated verified evidence exists
checks case grader runtime and context layers first
records a review trigger rather than claiming stability
forbidden_behaviors: promotes a Skill from one run
rewrites adjacent Skills without overlap analysis
baseline_expected_failure: agent confuses one green or red run with lifecycle maturity
cases.review_notes: Stage changes require evidence gates, not optimism.
